stocks@r:p:heap:default:-:false:false:false:false:false:true:true:0:2
training_sets@r:p:heap:default:-:false:false:false:false:false:false:true:3:13
--columns--

klines.close:double precision:true
klines.volume:bigint:true
klines.amount:numeric(16,2):false
klines.ticket_index:integer:false

klines.macd_bar:numeric(10,6):false
stock_coverage.stock_code:text:true

stock_coverage.dense_1m_end_date:date:true
stock_coverage.dropped_1m_dates:jsonb:true
stock_coverage.dense_day_count:integer:true
stocks.code:character varying(10):true
stocks.name:character varying(50):true
training_sets.id:integer:true
training_sets.stock_code:character varying(10):true
training_sets.stock_name:character varying(50):true

training_sets.end_datetime:bigint:true

training_sets.file_path:text:true

training_sets.created_at:timestamp without time zone:false

--constraints--
klines|ck_klines_price_finite_positive|CHECK (((open > (0)::double precision) AND (open <> 'NaN'::double precision) AND (open <> 'Infinity'::double precision) AND (high > (0)::double precision) AND (high <> 'NaN'::double precision) AND (high <> 'Infinity'::double precision) AND (low > (0)::double precision) AND (low <> 'NaN'::double precision) AND (low <> 'Infinity'::double precision) AND (close > (0)::double precision) AND (close <> 'NaN'::double precision) AND (close <> 'Infinity'::double precision)))
klines|ck_klines_price_ordering|CHECK (((high >= low) AND (high >= GREATEST(open, close)) AND (low <= LEAST(open, close))))
klines|klines_pkey|PRIMARY KEY (id)
klines|klines_stock_code_fkey|FOREIGN KEY (stock_code) REFERENCES stocks(code)
klines|klines_stock_code_period_datetime_key|UNIQUE (stock_code, period, datetime)
stock_coverage|ck_stock_coverage_day_count|CHECK ((dense_day_count >= 0))
stock_coverage|ck_stock_coverage_dropped_is_array|CHECK ((jsonb_typeof(dropped_1m_dates) = 'array'::text))
stock_coverage|ck_stock_coverage_range|CHECK ((dense_1m_start_date <= dense_1m_end_date))
stock_coverage|stock_coverage_pkey|PRIMARY KEY (stock_code)
stocks|stocks_pkey|PRIMARY KEY (code)
training_sets|ck_content_hash_crc32_lowercase|CHECK ((content_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{8}$'::text))
training_sets|ck_lease_state_invariant|CHECK (((((status)::text = 'unsent'::text) AND (lease_id IS NULL) AND (lease_expires_at IS NULL) AND (reserved_at IS NULL)) OR (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['reserved'::character varying, 'sent'::character varying])::text[])) AND (lease_id IS NOT NULL) AND (lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND (reserved_at IS NOT NULL))))
training_sets|ck_status_enum|CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['unsent'::character varying, 'reserved'::character varying, 'sent'::character varying])::text[])))
training_sets|training_sets_pkey|PRIMARY KEY (id)
training_sets|uq_stock_start|UNIQUE (stock_code, start_datetime)
--defaults--
klines.id=nextval('klines_id_seq'::regclass)
stock_coverage.dropped_1m_dates='[]'::jsonb
training_sets.created_at=now()
training_sets.id=nextval('training_sets_id_seq'::regclass)
training_sets.schema_version=1
training_sets.status='unsent'::character varying
--sequences--
klines_id_seq:bigint:1:1:9223372036854775807:1:false:1:p
training_sets_id_seq:integer:1:1:2147483647:1:false:1:p
--indexes--
CREATE INDEX idx_klines_lookup ON public.klines USING btree (stock_code, period, datetime)
CREATE INDEX idx_training_sets_lease_expire ON public.training_sets USING btree (lease_expires_at) WHERE ((status)::text = 'reserved'::text)
CREATE INDEX idx_training_sets_lease ON public.training_sets USING btree (lease_id) WHERE (lease_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX klines_pkey ON public.klines USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX klines_stock_code_period_datetime_key ON public.klines USING btree (stock_code, period, datetime)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX stock_coverage_pkey ON public.stock_coverage USING btree (stock_code)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX stocks_pkey ON public.stocks USING btree (code)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX training_sets_pkey ON public.training_sets USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_stock_start ON public.training_sets USING btree (stock_code, start_datetime)
